scope: Source actor provenance across tenant and platform lanes

findings.claim: P09 inbound messaging binds registered SERVICE/customer-channel only after token-derived tenant account/provider resolution, signature/freshness verification and active-account checks. Scoped binding surrounds Customer/Conversation processing and is restored afterward; it is not a permissive HTTP fallback or a body-selected actor.
findings.proof: Valid signed HTTP callback produces exactly two customer/conversation facts attributed to customer-channel, with no human or initiating-user identity. Invalid and stale signatures with a distinct sender/message payload create no additional facts.
findings.adjacent_inspection: P11 telephony and P12 voice callbacks mutate their own repositories and do not call CustomerService or current P22 hooks. No extra provenance fallback was added there.

findings.claim: HTTP HUMAN binding follows verified bearer claims and live session/user/membership/Organization validation, includes session UUID, and is fenced by Organization, RequestContext identity and asyncio task identity.

Registered internal org-only service seams can use finite SERVICE identity outside HTTP context; missing HTTP provenance fails closed. Principal-taking tool, P13 and P17 seams validate human identity. Membership self-suspension captures actor before mutation.

P13 execution actor derives from persisted agent/session/turn; initiating_user_id is separate from executing AI. Both P08 tool and P13 tool-completion intents retain AI attribution. Explicit stop/cancel preserves source actor.

Sentinel global operator identity comes from live platform authority; service identities are registered. PLATFORM organization_id is null, even when operator login uses a tenant session. No fake Organization or Sentinel ledger authority is introduced.

historical_findings.finding: Root combined run reported 2874 passed / 2 failed with 91.39% coverage. One genuine runtime failure was valid signed P09 HTTP webhook returning 403 because downstream customer audit lacked trusted actor provenance.
historical_findings.resolution: Owning verified-webhook boundary explicitly binds registered customer-channel service; seven focused tests passed. The other CLI failure was root-owned. Both failures are absent in the verified final local suite of 2876 passing tests.

historical_findings.finding: Post-mutation actor revalidation blocked legitimate self-suspension; test principal fixture had nonexistent sessions.
historical_findings.resolution: Validate/capture actor before mutation; fixture now registers and authenticates real live sessions.

historical_findings.finding: P13 human stop/cancel attributed to AI; P17 direct Principal path could become SERVICE.
historical_findings.resolution: Source-specific stop/cancel actor and explicit validated principal binding; independent re-review reports no remaining producer finding.
